clips.title: The story
paras: Regthar Deathgate seeks Verog's Head as proof of the Kolkar leader's death. The chieftain commands forces around the Stagnant Oasis, and his defeat is meant to weaken the tribes threatening the Barrens.

The Kolkar centaur threaten Horde travelers and supply routes across the northern Barrens. Verog the Dervish roams the arid scrubland, leaving his command tent at the Stagnant Oasis vulnerable. Horde operatives attack his forces around the pavilion until an alarm sounds. Verog rushes back to defend his camp, where he is slain and decapitated. Regthar Deathgate receives his head as proof that another dangerous Kolkar chieftain has fallen. Barak Kodobane's head is already on display beside it.
